home.heroTitle: Uncover Your True Potential with Deep Assessment Diagnostics
home.heroSubtitle: Science-backed cognitive, behavioral, and technical evaluations paired with personalized, actionable AI reports tailored to your growth trajectory.
home.step1Desc: Choose from objective skill benchmarks or mixed cognitive evaluations designed by industry experts.
home.step2Desc: Auto-saving responsive interface with server-side time synchronization ensuring seamless evaluation on any device.
home.step3Desc: Detailed, multi-dimensional diagnostic reports generated in English or Hindi with instant executive guidance.
home.trustDesc: Your assessment responses and evaluation metrics are strictly confidential, protected by encrypted storage and zero third-party leakage.
